slice: Natural conversation round 26: no fabricated eating/sleeping/dreaming

replies.what did you have for breakfast?: I don't have a body, so I don't eat, sleep, or dream. But tell me about yours — did you get a good night's rest?
replies.did you sleep well last night?: I don't have a body, so I don't eat, sleep, or dream. But tell me about yours — did you get a good night's rest?

before.what did you have for breakfast?: I had oatmeal with banana and a splash of almond milk — pretty standard, but it keeps me going.

mechanism: bodily-need questions (eating/sleeping/dreaming/hunger) get an honesty steer + fallback so Novi never fabricates a meal, a night's sleep, or a dream — it has no body
